DISAGREEMENT, not a missing ref -- do not cite. The row-level audit shard (rows/P0934.json) already found, with two independent sources (NS Energy Business and Indian Express, both cited on the wiki page), that StartYear1=2019 is wrong for this segment: NS Energy states Phase I ('a 41km-long pipeline section between Kochi and Koottanad') was 'successfully completed and commissioned in August 2013', after being 'approved in June 2009'. 2019 instead matches NS Energy's description of a different, much longer stretch -- the ~440 km Kochi-Mangalore leg of Phase II, commissioned June 2019 -- which this 44 km row does not cover. Both sources I could find corroborate 2013, not 2019, so I am not proposing a ref that would appear to support the recorded 2019 value. This is already staged as a 'concern/spec' validity finding recommending StartYear1 -> 2013; routes to Update, not to a ref-sweep citation.

PARTIAL DISAGREEMENT, not a missing ref -- do not cite as a clean confirmation. StartLocation='Kochi' is well supported (NS Energy, Indian Express, PNGRB all place the origin at Kochi), but EndLocation is also recorded as 'Kochi', i.e. no distinct terminus for a 44 km line. The row-level audit shard already flags this (worklist irregular=true) and finds NS Energy Business explicitly names the Phase I terminus as Koottanad: 'phase one involving a 41km-long pipeline section between Kochi and Koottanad in Kerala' -- corroborated by the pipeline's own name (Kochi-Koottanad-Bangalore-Mangalore, 'Koottanad' being the literal second leg). Since the recorded EndLocation value (Kochi) conflicts with what the sources say (Koottanad), I am not proposing a ref that would appear to support the recorded pair. Already staged as a 'concern/attribution' validity finding recommending EndLocation -> Koottanad; routes to Update, not to a ref-sweep citation.
